what: GridGenerator::cheese() in 3d created no holes at all; it produced a solid block.
trigger: Whole 3d branch never implemented the holes
test_note: The stored output of grid_generator_from_name_and_argument_01 recorded 315 cells, the hole-free count; the correct count is 291. The fix added an assertion on the cell count derived by hand (29 in 2d, 291 in 3d).
age: Traced: added in commit 9d076c3 on 28 June 2015; no earlier mention in the history back to 1997. About 10.8 years.

what: The distortion check after refinement had a dim == spacedim overload that did the check and a general fallback that did nothing. Every call named both template arguments, so the fallback was always chosen and the check never ran.
test_note: A check that never runs produces no output to compare. Found when a development version of Clang warned that the function was unused.
age: Traced: correct when added in 2009 (01ced5c), when the overloads were chosen by tag dispatch; broke in commit 6ceb8b7, merged in #11178 on 4 December 2020. About 5.7 years.

what: Multigrid W- and F-cycles overwrote intermediate solutions between cycles, so they behaved as V-cycles. Results were correct; only the work needed to reach them was greater than the chosen cycle should need.
test_note: The existing test (tests/multigrid/cycles.cc, renamed cycles_01) was unchanged and passed both before and after the fix; a new test, cycles_02, was added.
age: Traced: began with commit 8ebd391, merged in #4494 in June 2017. About 8.9 years.

what: PETScWrappers::SparseMatrix::memory_consumption() always returned 0.
age: Traced: the implementation using MatGetInfo's memory field dates from November 2009. When it began returning 0 depends on when PETSc stopped filling that field, which deal.II's history cannot show; at most about 15.7 years.

what: FE_Nedelec interpolation in 3d did not reproduce polynomials in its own space (wrong face support points, boundary contributions and interior ordering).
test_note: The existing test interpolate_nedelec was extended and its stored output grew; the commit references issue #328, an issue number from about December 2014.
age: Traced: the fix refers to issue #328, from about December 2014. About 11.8 years.

what: CylindricalManifold::push_forward_gradient() was missing a factor of the radius in the angular derivative, so the Jacobian was wrong for every radius other than 1 (e.g. MappingManifold on cylinders).
test_note: Test: manifold_gradient_check.

what: PETSc Krylov solvers called through PETScWrappers converged on the norm of the preconditioned residual, not the unpreconditioned residual deal.II's convention and examples assume. Results were correct; the solves could take more work than necessary.
trigger: Any PETSc solve with a preconditioner
test_note: Nine stored output files changed, including those of the step-17, step-18 and step-40 example tests.
age: Traced: since the PETSc solver wrappers were introduced in March 2004. About 22.2 years.

what: PETScWrappers::SparseDirectMUMPS::solve(A, x, b) set up the solver and factorization only on its first call; later calls with a different matrix reused the first one.
trigger: Calling solve() repeatedly with changing matrices
test_note: Test: sparse_direct_mumps_reuse.
age: Branch refers to issue #2869, from about July 2016. Changed code: median 8.3 years

what: ARKODE::solve_ode() and IDA::solve_dae() returned the number of output calls, not the number of time steps the documentation promised.
trigger: Any use of the return value
test_note: Stored outputs of arkode_01 and ida_01 changed (test sources were also updated).

what: PETSc VectorBase::mean_value() and lp_norm() iterated over the wrong range on distributed vectors.
AffineConstraints::make_consistent_in_parallel() made constraints agree across processes, but the agreed constraints were occasionally wrong.
test_note: Three new tests; one existing stored output changed.

what: ParticleHandler assumed every cell was a quadrilateral or hexahedron when testing whether a particle lay in a cell, and on simplex or mixed meshes sometimes put particles in the wrong cells.
test_note: Stored outputs of the simplex step-68 test changed with no change to the test itself, so they had recorded the wrong placements.

what: FEPointEvaluation::get_gradient() returned wrong results on meshes mixing affine and non-affine cells when several points were evaluated on affine cells. The changelog notes this affected the step-19 tutorial.
test_note: Test: point_evaluation_39.

what: FEFaceValues and FESubfaceValues could give wrong metric terms when reinitialised on the same cell after the triangulation had changed.
trigger: Reuse of FE*Values objects across mesh changes
test_note: Test: mapping_q_reinit.

what: MatrixFree::cell_loop() with BlockVector types and more than 20 components zeroed vectors at the wrong moment, giving wrong results.
test_note: Test: matrix_vector_blocks_2.

what: MGTwoLevelTransfer::reinit() with geometric coarsening computed wrong prolongation, restriction and interpolation for elements with more than one component and no tensor-product structure.
test_note: Test: mg_transfer_a_08.

what: FEEvaluation::submit_curl() for FE_NedelecNodal in 2d used the curl of the first cell for every cell in a vectorised batch.
trigger: Vectorised cell batches with differing cells
test_note: Test: matrix_vector_curl_nedelec.

what: FEEvaluation::get_gradient() for FE_RaviartThomasNodal on non-parallelogram cells read values that submit_value() had already overwritten.
trigger: Calling submit_value() before get_gradient() at the same point
test_note: Existing tests matrix_vector_rt_04 and rt_face_04 were extended with a case that calls submit_value() before get_gradient().

what: Wrong normal direction for the last component of Raviart-Thomas elements in the matrix-free evaluation kernels.
MatrixFree::get_cell_active_fe_index() returned the wrong value when cells were categorised, affecting MatrixFreeTools::compute_diagonal().
test_note: Stored outputs of compute_diagonal_01 changed (test also extended).

what: MatrixFreeTools::compute_diagonal() used first_selected_component when indexing (block) vectors as well.
trigger: Non-zero first component with block vectors
test_note: Existing test compute_diagonal_07 changed.

what: MGConstrainedDoFs and DoFTools::make_periodicity_constraints() set up periodic constraints inconsistently.
test_note: Three existing stored outputs changed with no change to their tests, so they had recorded the inconsistent constraints.

what: Triangulation::copy_triangulation() did not copy the periodic-face information.
test_note: Test: copy_triangulation_pbc.

what: Periodic boundaries in parallel::distributed::Triangulation were not identified correctly when the two sides had different face orientations.
test_note: Test: 2d_periodicity_01.

what: communicate_locally_moved_vertices() could leave stale vertex positions on ghost cells not adjacent to the moved vertex's owner.
test_note: Stored outputs of distort_random_02 (about 5,500 changed lines) changed with no change to the test, so they had recorded stale positions.

what: parallel::shared::Triangulation::add_periodicity() did not put neighbours across periodic faces into the ghost layer until the next refinement.
test_note: Test: pbc_02.

what: DoFTools::extract_dofs_with_support_contained_within() reported DoFs as contained in parallel runs when they were not.
test_note: Test: dof_tools_extract_dofs_with_support_contained_within_06.

what: FETools::extrapolate() did not compress ghost values correctly with LinearAlgebra::distributed vectors.
trigger: deal.II's own distributed vectors (PETSc/Trilinos behaved differently)
test_note: The shared helper used by the fe_tools_extrapolate tests was changed.

what: When building a parallel::fullydistributed::Triangulation, child cells were given their parent's material id even when theirs differed.
trigger: Distinct material ids on refined cells
test_note: Test: copy_serial_tria_13.

what: quarter_hyper_shell() did not set the top boundary id for thin shells.
test_note: Test: grid_generator_hyper_shell.

what: half_hyper_shell() set top and bottom boundary ids incorrectly for thin shells.
test_note: The stored output of grid_generator_half_hyper_shell changed with no change to its test; a new test was also added.

what: cylinder_shell() with colorize could assign wrong boundary ids for aspect ratios far from the default.
test_note: Existing test extended with the failing cases.

what: PolynomialsVectorAnisotropic::evaluate() did not overwrite all of its output arrays, leaving earlier contents in place.
test_note: Test: polynomials_vector_anisotropic_eval.

what: ParameterHandler::parse_input_from_json() silently accepted undeclared parameters in nested subsections.
test_note: Test: parameter_handler_read_json_06.

what: Geometric multigrid transfer narrowed 64-bit indices to 32 bits.
test_note: Exercising it would need a problem with more than 2^31 unknowns.
